overview: Black plays ...a6 before White commits the bishop, which prepares ...dxc4 and ...b5 with a faster Meran-style queenside expansion. White may play 6.Bd3 or 6.b3, or push c5. Black aims for ...c5 and an active bishop on b7 against a solid White centre.

white_ideas.idea: Develop with Bd3 and e4 or play b3 against the Meran set-up
Take space with c5 and attack on the kingside

typical_structures.structure: Semi-Slav centre with tension on c4 and d5, Meran-type queenside play

character.notes: The Meran is a well-mapped theory battle but both sides are sound, so it is balanced rather than sharp or solid.

gambit.notes: Black's ...dxc4 pawn is usually regained by White.

structure.notes: Centre tension on c4, d4 and d5 with an undecided pawn structure.

approach.notes: A normal Semi-Slav move order played at club and master level.

level.notes: The plans are understandable though the theory is deep, so Intermediate.
